_doc: AgentID issuer profile for tools/issuer_profile.py (jws-eddsa). keys[0] = hex of the OKP/Ed25519 'x' served at https://getagentid.dev/.well-known/jwks.json under kid agentid-2026-03. NOTE: the live protected header carries kid 'agentid-2026-03' (a JWKS label, RFC 7517), not the hex pubkey the jws-eddsa profile expects as kid -- see adapters/README.md (AgentID section) for the verbatim verify_envelope output.
